title: Operation “Helgoland Bite”: German-language influence activity
summary: OpenAI banned accounts that appeared to originate in Russia and used AI to generate German-language political content about Ukraine, NATO, and domestic issues.
body: OpenAI banned accounts that appeared to originate in Russia and used AI to generate German-language political content about Ukraine, NATO, and domestic issues.
summaryZh: OpenAI封禁了一批来自俄罗斯、利用人工智能生成关于乌克兰、北约及德国本土议题的德语政治虚假信息的违规账号，展示了对恶意利用LLM进行影响力活动的监控与打击成果。
